## About

**Team H1T** is a cybersecurity team working across offensive security, threat hunting, and open-source tool development. Our work spans competitive CTF play, red team operations, vulnerability research, and detection engineering.

<br/>

## What We Do

| Area | Description |
|---|---|
| **Red Team** | Offensive operations and adversary emulation |
| **CTF & Research** | Competitive hacking and vulnerability research |
| **Blue Team** | Detection engineering and incident response |
| **Tooling** | Open-source security tools and automation |

<br/>
